1.  Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks regular bail in FIR no. 705/2014 registered at Police Station Ashok Vihar for the offences punishable under Sections 363/366/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
